news.headline: Gayle Benson thanks the fans who went to Paris
news.summary: The Saints owner wrote an open letter to everyone who made the trip to France for Sunday's game. She said the score did not go their way, but New Orleans was represented well.

news.headline: The Saints are off this week and looking at everything
news.summary: Coach Kellen Moore said the bye week is for a top-to-bottom look at the team, starting with its slow starts. The Saints have been outscored 44 to 6 in the first quarter this season.

news.headline: Steelers beat the Saints 16-10 in Paris
news.summary: The Saints lost Sunday morning at Stade de France, in the first National Football League game ever played in France. They ran for only 18 yards all day, and they are now 2-5.

nextGame.note: Florida plays Georgia in Atlanta on Halloween afternoon. Half past two our time. Georgia is ranked third in the country and has won six games and lost one.

news.headline: Aaron Philo will start at quarterback for Florida
news.summary: Florida will start Aaron Philo against Georgia on Saturday. He hurt his shoulder against South Carolina on October 10 and missed the Texas game, and Tramell Jones started that one instead.

news.headline: Florida's leading receiver is likely to play at Georgia
news.summary: Florida says Vernell Brown III will probably play Saturday against Georgia. He leads the team in catches and has been on the hurt list for four weeks with a knee injury.

news.headline: Both Florida quarterbacks are banged up for Georgia
news.summary: Florida listed Aaron Philo and Tramell Jones as questionable for Saturday's game at Georgia, which means neither one is certain to play. Coach Jon Sumrall said both are available and that he will pick the starter based on who is healthy.

nextGame.note: Saturday afternoon home game against Alabama in Baton Rouge. Half past two our time. LSU is off this coming Saturday, so this game is two Saturdays away. Alabama is ranked 10th in the country and has won six games and lost two.

news.headline: LSU and Alabama will play at 2:30 on ABC
news.summary: The conference set the kickoff time on Monday for the November 7 game in Baton Rouge. It is the first afternoon start for this game in Tiger Stadium since 2010.

news.headline: Sam Leavitt and Jordan Ross win conference awards
news.summary: Leavitt threw for 378 yards and three touchdowns and ran for another score in Saturday's win at Auburn. Ross had two sacks in the same game, and the SEC honored both of them on Monday.

news.headline: LSU moves up to No. 15
news.summary: Beating Auburn moved LSU up three spots in the Associated Press Top 25, from 18th to 15th. The Tigers have won six games and lost two.

nextGame.note: Friday night road game at Charlotte. Six o'clock our time. Charlotte has won one game and lost six.

news.headline: Tulane's freshman quarterback makes his first road start
news.summary: Trace Johnson has started two games for Tulane, both at home. Friday night at Charlotte will be his first start on the road.

news.headline: Two Tulane running backs are banged up
news.summary: Jamauri McClure hurt his foot again on his first carry against UTSA and ran the ball only four times. Maurice Turner did not play in that game at all.

news.headline: Tulane will start its fifth different offensive line
news.summary: Coach Will Hall said the Green Wave will put out their fifth different starting offensive line of the season on Friday night at Charlotte. He said the group is really banged up, and young players who have not played much will have to fill in.
